summary.text: Marc Malon is a Democratic state representative from Biddeford, Maine, who has represented District 133 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously worked as party affairs director of the Maine Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Malon lives in Biddeford, Maine, and earned a B.A. in political science/public communications in 2005 and an M.A. in political science in 2007, both from American University.

Malon's career experience includes working as party affairs director of the Maine Democratic Party, as a legislative and press liaison with the Office of the Maine Attorney General, and as a legislative aide with the Office of the Maine Speaker of the House.
He took office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022, and Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Bills in the Second Reading Committee for 2025-2026.
